method: Direct HTTP GETs were made sequentially with at least 1.3 seconds between requests. HTTP status is the final response after redirects. SHA-256 covers the saved, content-decoded response body, including any HTML error or challenge page. The response notes identify the bytes that carry source text. Transient redirect parameters and signed queries are omitted.
Capture timestamps are UTC and come from the replay address. A failed replay records the requested timestamp and hashes its response body. Live scans are separate witnesses.

The Gwern addresses are absent from research/held-records-2026-11-04/codex-report.md and its JSON companion. This report uses the three blocked Gwern rows in research/archive-batch-2026-11-04/codex-report.md, also listed in research/archive-verification-2026-10-28/codex-report.md.

bibliography.title: Space-Based Data Centres: A Paradigm for Data Processing and Scientific Investigations
bibliography.locator: Springer article header, About this article, and citation metadata; Crossref message fields.

items.abstractSummary: The authors motivate space hosting with storage and access demand and constraints on expanding terrestrial capacity in densely populated regions. They propose satellite integration and cognitive computing, describe applications, and compare siting costs. The abstract reports a model for the opportunity cost of land and application latency. Its simulations report average land-cost reductions ranging from 3.3% to 66.3%, and 45.7% lower latency on average. The closing sentence speculates about applications to the search for extraterrestrial intelligence.
items.quotationLimit: One verbatim excerpt plus a summary for the copyrighted abstract. The typeset first-page transcription in the indexed ResearchGate view agrees on the quoted wording after line-break and ligature normalization. Its issue label is 107(3), whereas Springer and Crossref both give 107(1).

count.method: Extract each PDF page with PyMuPDF get_text() and count characters whose Unicode name contains CJK UNIFIED IDEOGRAPH. Main text includes clauses 1–6 and Annexes A–F, printed pp. 1–15 / PDF pp. 5–19. The whole-file count includes the cover, contents, foreword and introduction. Punctuation, Latin letters, digits and whitespace contribute zero. Labels embedded only in figure images are outside the extractable text layer.
